queries.query: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container)(node_namespace_pod_container:container_cpu_usage_seconds_total:sum_rate5m{cluster="$cluster"})) by (namespace) / sum(namespace_cpu:kube_pod_container_resource_requests:sum{cluster="$cluster"}) by (namespace)
